topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Master Eli's been talkin' 'bout puttin' up a fence 'tween his land and mine. I reckon it's his right, but somethin' don't feel quite right 'bout it. We've always shared these fields, ever since I was a lad. The cattle roam free, and the crops we plant stretch as far as the eye can see. Still, if he's of a mind to stake his claim, what can I say? The world turns, and so does the wheel of fortune. I'll speak to him, see what's troubling him so. Mayhaps a bit of talk under the old oak will do us both good. The saints be with us, and the earth bless our feet.
